reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative: The project aims to support about 1400 fisheries in the Gaza Strip to maintain and fix their fishing boats. Maintaining the boats will improve the fishing boats' performance, safety, and productivity so that the poor fishermen can ship in deeper fishing zones, catch more fish and generate more income. The fixed boats will also be more environmentally friendly with less emission of gases, less oil and petrol spills in the sea, and less fuel consumption. While men dominate the fishery sector, women contribute to this sector through logistics, storage, and, to a lesser extent, marketing. This project includes a social dimension while addressing the socio-economic conditions of the households to reduce the burden of economic and social stress on women. The project will ensure and monitor fishing trends to prevent overfishing and protect the Gaza Sea's marine life. December 1 2022 until Nov 30 2025.
